title: If a move fails partway, nobody is changed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A (made for this test), due 15 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly three customers made for this test (a new term holds only this case's customers).
  • Make sure Net 45 is active.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 3 Customers" while the move cannot complete.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A window titled "Move Customers from term A" opens.

Step 3:

  • The dropdown shows Net 45.

Step 4:

  • The app's error alert shows "Couldn't move the customers. Nothing was changed. Please try again." The window stays open and all three customers are still on term A with no note.

A manual tester cannot force a failure in the middle of a move; this is for an automated check or a developer-made failure.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • Story 4, Error Handling: “If the move fails partway, no customer is changed (all or nothing) and the app's standard error alert shows "Couldn't move the customers. Nothing was changed. Please try again." The window stays open.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move fails partway | "Couldn't move the customers. Nothing was changed. Please try again." | Standard error alert, window stays open”
